# S13 — Wire the daemon, CLI and TUI into the ork binary

`cmd/ork` dispatches subcommands to `internal/cli`, starts the daemon on
demand by re-executing itself as `ork daemon run`, and the TUI reads
through the socket client instead of `source.Direct` (`dash.pre-daemon`).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**2026-10-19** — From S03 (2026-10-19): an idle daemon unlinks its socket before releasing the pidfile lock, so a start racing that exit gets ErrAlreadyRunning; treat it as transient and reuse App.connect's StartWait (internal/cli/cli.go:175-195) instead of a second 5 s wait. Package-level cli.Run has no Start function; S13 builds an App with Start.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**2026-10-19** — From S15 (2026-10-19): Cache.Forget does not cancel in-flight reads, and a snapshot or status that loaded the registry before projects rm can re-create the forgotten project's entries (handlers.go:281, cache.go:139). Notices go out one connection at a time from the cache's read goroutine (subscribe.go), so a stuck subscriber delays others up to the 10 s write timeout. With no subscriber every project is still read every 30 s until idle exit. ork status text shows no part ages (JSON does). Open records follow the 5 s / 30 s tick, as the integration review's R2 table has it.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

## Why

(`plan.s03-wiring`); this joins them.

## Files

- `cmd/ork/main.go`, `internal/tui/` (the Source it is given), and an
  `internal/ipc` Source client if S03 did not add one.

## Failing tests

- `ork` with no arguments opens the TUI; `ork status` etc. reach
  `internal/cli`; `ork daemon run` serves the socket.
- The TUI's Source over a real in-process socket returns the same snapshot
  as `source.Direct` on the same fakes.

## Implement

- The start function execs `os.Executable()` with `daemon run`, detached
  in its own process group, and waits for the socket up to 5 s.
